info.name: Looking for the Wiseman in Ellinia
info.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

descriptions.inProgress: I handed Dances with Balrog 2 Power Crystals and received the 1st #bold piece of map#k. The map is cut in four pieces, each piece held by a wiseman. He wanted me to gather up all four pieces of the map, find the Book of Ancient through it, and seal it up for good. Next up: The wiseman in #bEllinia#k.
